newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 posts rare rebound led by SPT, Komercni.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 posts rare rebound led by SPT, Komercni.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index rallied on Wednesday led by strong gains to SPT Telecom, which accounts for 21 percent of market capitalisation, and Komercni Banka, which accounts for 11 percent.
Czech PX50 rose 9.1 points, 1.69 percent, to 547 while the Reuters RPIX moved up 28.3 points, 2.54 percent, to 1,144.
SPT rose 140 crowns to 3,450 and Komercni rose 74 crowns to 2,296. CEZ gained 15 crowns to 1,060.
"For all the blue chips it seems to be a little bit similiar. (But) I don't see it as a signal that the blue chips are being targeted by investors again," said Ivan Kusacek of Zivnostenska Banka.
Overall, activity on the bourse was very thin. As a result, many dealers urged caution before interpreting Wednesday's gains as the beginning of a turnaround.
"I would say we should wait a couple of days to see if the trend will continue...I wouldn't get optimistic just because of today," said Petr Opocensky of Citicorp Securities.

Skoda Plzen continued to rise, gaining 20 crowns to 885, after the company announced on Tuesday it had won a $170 million order to supply trolley buses to San Francisco. The deal must still be approved by the San Francisco board of supervisors.
